Ensure the curriculum vitae contains your Name (in block letters), Permanent/ Present Address, E-mail Address, Telephone/Mobile No., Parent’s/ Spouse’s Name, Date of Birth, Academic Qualifications (with percentage of marks obtained in each examination starting from 10th class), Experience (if any), Aadhaar Card/ Voter Card/ PAN Card details, and SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status.

content_sections.heading: About ISI Research Associate (RA-I)
content_sections.text: Indian Statistical Institute is an autonomous body funded by the Ministry of Statistics and Program Implementation, Government of India. The institute's headquarters is situated at 203, B. T. Road, Kolkata - 700 108. The engagement for this Research Associate position is being made purely on a temporary basis within the Statistical Quality Control & Operations Research (SQC & OR) Division.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility conditions as specified in the recruitment notice: Nationality: Indian Nationals only. Educational Qualification: PhD in Statistics / Mathematics / Computer Science / Engineering. Competencies & Skills: Knowledge of Reliability/ Survival Analysis/ Statistical Learning/ Machine Learning, and proficiency in R/ Python or any other programming language. Age Limit: Upper age limit shall be 35 years as on 01 October 2026. Age Relaxation: Usual relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled candidates. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Associate (RA-I) will receive a pay of Rs. 58,000/- (Rupees fifty-eight thousand only) plus House Rent Allowance as per the rules of the Institute per month. The tenure will be initially up to 31 March 2027 from the date of joining the Institute. The engagement may be extended later or terminated earlier depending on the availability of funds and candidate performance. Based on performance, the term of research associateship may be extended up to a maximum of two years, as per the discretion of the Institute. Engagement of the Research Associate will take place in line with Office Order No. D.O./2024/183 dated 20 June 2024 and Office Memorandum No. SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30 January 2019 of the Department of Science & Technology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: ISI Research Associate (RA-I) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work in the Statistical Quality Control & Operations Research Division in Kolkata on the following broad areas of work: Lifetime Data Analysis Applications of Machine Learning to Reliability/ Survival Analysis

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Research Associate (RA-I)
content_sections.text: Prepare a cover letter and a curriculum vitae merged together as a single PDF file addressed to the Head, Statistical Quality Control and Operations Research Division of the Indian Statistical Institute. Ensure the curriculum vitae contains your Name (in block letters), Permanent/ Present Address, E-mail Address, Telephone/Mobile No., Parent’s/ Spouse’s Name, Date of Birth, Academic Qualifications (with percentage of marks obtained in each examination starting from 10th class), Experience (if any), Aadhaar Card/ Voter Card/ PAN Card details, and SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status. Include self-attested soft copies of all documents/testimonials, a research statement, a teaching statement, and two recommendations including one from your Ph.D. supervisor(s). Send the compiled PDF via email to [email protected] . Ensure the application is sent latest by 09 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting based on applications, followed by an assessment in Kolkata: Candidates who are shortlisted will need to make an open presentation. The presentation will be followed by an interaction in the presence of the selection committee. Shortlisted candidate(s) will be notified by email at the address provided by the applicant. No TA/DA will be paid either for appearing the interview or joining the post.
